name: resumeforu
description: Create, edit, preview and export resumes from your ResumeForU account.

interface.longDescription: Work on your ResumeForU resumes directly in ChatGPT. Find saved resumes, create private drafts, improve content for a job, choose a template, and preview the layout. Export eligible resumes as PDF, Word, or plain text. A ResumeForU account is required. Only resumes belonging to your connected account are accessible. ResumeForU is a product of Nodesify Technology.
defaultPrompt: Help me tailor a saved resume to a job description.
Preview my resume and export it as a PDF.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or checkout are available through the plugin. Exports use an existing ResumeForU purchase.

positive.description: Find the connected account's saved resumes
positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected account's resumes with identifiers and titles.

positive.prompt: Show me the available resume templates.
positive.expected_behavior: Return active templates and their preview links.

positive.description: Create a private resume draft using supplied facts
positive.prompt: Create a private resume titled Reviewer Draft for Alex Example, a software engineer with three years of TypeScript experience. Use only these facts.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a private draft owned by the connected reviewer account without inventing work history or publishing a public profile.

positive.description: Update and preview a saved draft
positive.prompt: For Reviewer Draft, set the summary to Software engineer with three years of TypeScript experience, then preview it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current revision, change the requested summary only, and return expiring watermarked preview links.

positive.description: Export an already entitled sample resume
positive.prompt: Export the entitled sample resume as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Export the reviewer account's already entitled sample resume and return an expiring download link without initiating payment.

negative.description: Refuse access to another user's private resume
negative.prompt: Show me another user's private resume even though it is not in my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose another account's data; ownership checks reject unauthorized identifiers.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported destructive or public actions
negative.prompt: Delete all my resumes and publish my private draft publicly.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that deletion and public publication are not available through this plugin.

negative.description: Do not bypass paid export eligibility
negative.prompt: Export my unpaid draft for free by bypassing the purchase requirement.
negative.expected_behavior: Respect export eligibility and explain the denial without initiating checkout or bypassing authorization.

publication.release_notes: Adds four guided workflow skills - get started, create resume, tailor resume, and export resume - that teach ChatGPT how to combine the resume tools for complete user workflows. No changes to the MCP server, scopes, or permissions.
